GERMANCREDIT CLASIFICACION¶

Acerca del conjunto de datos

El conjunto de datos original contiene 1000 entradas con 20 atributos categóricos/simbólicos, preparado por el profesor Hofmann. En este conjunto de datos, cada entrada representa a una persona que solicita un crédito bancario. Cada persona se clasifica como de riesgo crediticio alto o bajo según el conjunto de atributos. El enlace al conjunto de datos original se encuentra a continuación.

Contenido

  • Edad (numérico)
  • Sexo (texto: masculino, femenino)
  • Trabajo (numérico: 0 - no cualificado y no residente, 1 - no cualificado y residente, 2 - cualificado, 3 - altamente cualificado)
  • Cuenta de ahorros: (pequeña, moderada, muy buena, buena, nodata)
  • Vivienda (texto: propia, de alquiler o gratuita) Cuentas de ahorro (texto: poco, moderado, bastante rico, rico)
  • Cuenta corriente (numérico, en marcos alemanes)
  • Importe del crédito (numérico, en marcos alemanes)
  • Duración (numérico, en meses)
  • Propósito (texto: coche, muebles/equipo, radio/TV, electrodomésticos, reparaciones, educación, negocios, vacaciones/otros)

OBJETIVO

Evaluar modelos de clasificación para prediccion de riesgo de nuevos clientes

Ordenar las variables categoricas¶

In [417]:
# ================================
# VARIABLES POR TIPO
# ================================

# Variable objetivo
target = 'riesgo'

# Numéricas (ajusta según tu df real)
numCols = df.select_dtypes(include=['int64', 'float64']).columns.to_list()
if target in numCols:
    numCols.remove(target)

# Binarias
binCols = ['sexo']

# Nominales (sin orden natural)
catCols = ['proposito']

# Ordinales (con orden definido)
ordCols = ['cuenta ahorros', 'vivienda', 'cuenta cheques', 'rango_edad', 'rango_credito']

# Mapeo de orden por variable
ord_mappings = {
    'cuenta ahorros': ['no data', 'pequeña', 'moderada', 'buena', 'muy buena'],
    'vivienda': ['arriendo', 'libre', 'propia'],
    'cuenta cheques': ['no data', 'pequeña', 'moderada', 'buena'],
    'rango_edad': ['Adolescente', 'Joven', 'Adulto', 'Mayor'],
    'rango_credito': ['sin_credito', 'bajo', 'medio', 'alto', 'muy_alto']
}

# Crear lista de categorías en el orden que espera OrdinalEncoder
ord_categories = [ord_mappings[col] for col in ordCols]

Encoders¶

In [418]:
# ============================================
# 2️⃣ PIPELINES POR TIPO DE VARIABLE
# ============================================

# Numéricas → imputación + escalado
num_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='median')),
    ('scaler', StandardScaler())
])

# Binarias → imputación + codificación ordinal (0/1)
bin_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')),
    ('encoder', OrdinalEncoder())
])

# Nominales → imputación + one-hot encoding
cat_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')),
    ('encoder', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', sparse_output=False))
])

# Ordinales → imputación + codificación ordinal con orden definido
ord_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')),
    ('encoder', OrdinalEncoder(categories=ord_categories))
])

# ============================================
# 3️⃣ UNIR TODOS LOS PIPELINES EN UN COLUMNTRANSFORMER
# ============================================

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(transformers=[
    ('num', num_pipeline, numCols),
    ('bin', bin_pipeline, binCols),
    ('cat', cat_pipeline, catCols),
    ('ord', ord_pipeline, ordCols)
])

Evaluacion de modelos con el encoders nuevo¶

In [419]:
# ============================================
# 4️⃣ CREAR EL PIPELINE FINAL CON UN MODELO
# ============================================

model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    random_state=42,
    class_weight='balanced',
    n_jobs=-1
)

pipe = Pipeline([
    ('preproc', preprocessor),
    ('model', model)
])

# ============================================
# 5️⃣ DIVISIÓN DEL CONJUNTO DE DATOS Y ENTRENAMIENTO
# ============================================

X = df.drop(columns=[target])
y = df[target]

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

pipe.fit(X_train, y_train)

# ============================================
# 6️⃣ EVALUACIÓN DEL MODELO
# ============================================

y_pred = pipe.predict(X_test)

print("🔹 CLASSIFICATION REPORT")
print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred))

print("\n🔹 MATRIZ DE CONFUSIÓN")
print(confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred))

# ============================================
# 7️⃣ VER NOMBRES DE FEATURES TRANSFORMADOS (opcional)
# ============================================

feature_names = pipe.named_steps['preproc'].get_feature_names_out()
print("\nNombres de columnas después del preprocesamiento:")
print(feature_names)

Comparacion de modelos con el nuevo encoder¶

In [420]:
# ====================================================
# 🔧 COMPARACIÓN DE MODELOS - CORRECCIÓN COMPLETA
# ====================================================

from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_validate, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import GaussianNB
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ============================================
# 1️⃣ CODIFICAR VARIABLE OBJETIVO A BINARIA
# ============================================
# (asegúrate de haber definido X, y previamente)

le = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = le.fit_transform(y)

print("Clases codificadas:", dict(zip(le.classes_, le.transform(le.classes_))))

# ============================================
# 2️⃣ DEFINIR MODELOS A COMPARAR
# ============================================

models = {
    'Logistic Regression': LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, class_weight='balanced'),
    'SVM': SVC(kernel='rbf', probability=True, class_weight='balanced'),
    'KNN': KNeighborsClassifier(),
    'Decision Tree': DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42, class_weight='balanced'),
    'Random Forest': RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced', n_jobs=-1),
    'Gradient Boosting': GradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=42),
    'Naive Bayes': GaussianNB(),
    'MLP Neural Net': MLPClassifier(max_iter=500, random_state=42)
}

# ============================================
# 3️⃣ CONFIGURACIÓN DE VALIDACIÓN CRUZADA
# ============================================
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
scoring = {
    'accuracy': 'accuracy',
    'precision': 'precision_macro',
    'recall': 'recall_macro',
    'f1': 'f1_macro'
}

# ============================================
# 4️⃣ EVALUAR CADA MODELO
# ============================================

results = []

for name, model in models.items():
    pipe_model = Pipeline([
        ('preproc', preprocessor),
        ('model', model)
    ])
    
    scores = cross_validate(pipe_model, X, y_encoded, cv=cv, scoring=scoring, n_jobs=-1)
    
    results.append({
        'Modelo': name,
        'Accuracy': np.mean(scores['test_accuracy']),
        'Precision': np.mean(scores['test_precision']),
        'Recall': np.mean(scores['test_recall']),
        'F1': np.mean(scores['test_f1'])
    })

df_results = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values(by='F1', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

# ============================================
# 5️⃣ MOSTRAR RESULTADOS
# ============================================

print("\n🔹 RESULTADOS PROMEDIO DE VALIDACIÓN CRUZADA (5 folds):")
print(df_results.round(3))

# ============================================
# 6️⃣ GRAFICAR COMPARACIÓN
# ============================================

plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
plt.barh(df_results['Modelo'], df_results['F1'], color='cornflowerblue')
plt.xlabel('F1-score promedio (5-fold CV)')
plt.ylabel('Modelo')
plt.title('Comparación de modelos de clasificación')
plt.gca().invert_yaxis()
plt.show()

Clases codificadas: {'no_riesgo': np.int64(0), 'riesgoso': np.int64(1)}

# Use Cross-validation.
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score

# Logistic Regression
log_reg = LogisticRegression()
log_scores = cross_val_score(log_reg, X_train, y_train, cv=3)
log_reg_mean = log_scores.mean()

# SVC
svc_clf = SVC()
svc_scores = cross_val_score(svc_clf, X_train, y_train, cv=3)
svc_mean = svc_scores.mean()

# KNearestNeighbors
knn_clf = KNeighborsClassifier()
knn_scores = cross_val_score(knn_clf, X_train, y_train, cv=3)
knn_mean = knn_scores.mean()

# Decision Tree
tree_clf = tree.DecisionTreeClassifier()
tree_scores = cross_val_score(tree_clf, X_train, y_train, cv=3)
tree_mean = tree_scores.mean()

# Gradient Boosting Classifier
grad_clf = GradientBoostingClassifier()
grad_scores = cross_val_score(grad_clf, X_train, y_train, cv=3)
grad_mean = grad_scores.mean()

# Random Forest Classifier
rand_clf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=18)
rand_scores = cross_val_score(rand_clf, X_train, y_train, cv=3)
rand_mean = rand_scores.mean()

# NeuralNet Classifier
neural_clf = MLPClassifier(alpha=1, max_iter=500, random_state=42)
neural_scores = cross_val_score(neural_clf, X_train, y_train, cv=3)
neural_mean = neural_scores.mean()

# Naives Bayes
nav_clf = GaussianNB()
nav_scores = cross_val_score(nav_clf, X_train, y_train, cv=3)
nav_mean = neural_scores.mean()

# Create a Dataframe with the results.
d = {'Classifiers': ['Logistic Reg.', 'SVC', 'KNN', 'Dec Tree', 'Grad B CLF', 'Rand FC', 'Neural Classifier', 'Naives Bayes'], 
    'Crossval Mean Scores': [log_reg_mean, svc_mean, knn_mean, tree_mean, grad_mean, rand_mean, neural_mean, nav_mean]}

result_df = pd.DataFrame(data=d)

ROC CURVE¶

ROC CURVE RANDOM FOREST¶

In [36]:
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Entrenar y predecir
neural_clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_prob = neural_clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# ROC Curve
fpr, tpr, thresholds = roc_curve(y_test, y_prob, pos_label=1.0)
roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

# Graficar
plt.figure()
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f'ROC curve (AUC = {roc_auc:.2f})')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--')
plt.xlabel('False Positive Rate')
plt.ylabel('True Positive Rate')
plt.title('ROC Curve')
plt.legend(loc='lower right')
plt.show()

ROC CURVE RANDON FOREST Y MLPCLASSIFIER¶

In [37]:
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Entrenar modelos
rf_clf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42)
nn_clf = MLPClassifier(alpha=1, max_iter=500, random_state=42)

rf_clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
nn_clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Obtener probabilidades
rf_probs = rf_clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
nn_probs = nn_clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Calcular curvas ROC
fpr_rf, tpr_rf, _ = roc_curve(y_test, rf_probs, pos_label=1.0)
fpr_nn, tpr_nn, _ = roc_curve(y_test, nn_probs, pos_label=1.0)

# Calcular AUC
auc_rf = auc(fpr_rf, tpr_rf)
auc_nn = auc(fpr_nn, tpr_nn)

# Graficar
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.plot(fpr_rf, tpr_rf, label=f'Random Forest (AUC = {auc_rf:.2f})', color='green')
plt.plot(fpr_nn, tpr_nn, label=f'Neural Net (AUC = {auc_nn:.2f})', color='blue')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', label='Random Guess')
plt.xlabel('False Positive Rate')
plt.ylabel('True Positive Rate')
plt.title('ROC Curve Comparison')
plt.legend(loc='lower right')
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
In [38]:
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Asegúrate de que SVC tenga probability=True
svc_clf = SVC(probability=True)

# Diccionario de modelos
models = {
    'Logistic Reg.': LogisticRegression(),
    'SVC': svc_clf,
    'KNN': KNeighborsClassifier(),
    'Dec Tree': tree.DecisionTreeClassifier(),
    'Grad B CLF': GradientBoostingClassifier(),
    'Rand FC': RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=18),
    'Neural Classifier': MLPClassifier(alpha=1, max_iter=500, random_state=42),
    'Naives Bayes': GaussianNB()
}

# Graficar ROC curves
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))

for name, model in models.items():
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test, y_prob, pos_label=1.0)
    roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)
    plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f'{name} (AUC = {roc_auc:.3f})')

# Línea base
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', label='Random Guess')
plt.xlabel('False Positive Rate')
plt.ylabel('True Positive Rate')
plt.title('Comparación de ROC Curves - Todos los Modelos')
plt.legend(loc='lower right')
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
import pandas as pd

# Entrenar el modelo
modelo_rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
modelo_rf.fit(X, y)

# Obtener la importancia de las variables
importancias = modelo_rf.feature_importances_

# Crear DataFrame con las importancias
ranking_importancia = pd.DataFrame({
    'Variable': X.columns,
    'Importancia': importancias
}).sort_values(by='Importancia', ascending=False)

# Mostrar las 15 más importantes
top_variables = ranking_importancia.head(15)

# 🎨 Gráfico
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
ax = sns.barplot(x='Importancia', y='Variable', data=top_variables, palette='viridis')
ax.set_title('Top 15 Variables más Importantes - Random Forest')
ax.set_xlabel('Importancia')
ax.set_ylabel('Variable')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
